name: Chat Commands & Kits
author: SCUMSA
description: Your own in-game chat commands and reward kits. Players type a command and get a reply, an admin action, or a kit of items, vehicles and containers. A kit can have variants, so it gives something different each time — by chance or in turn. Free or priced in money, gold or fame, with cooldowns, claim limits and time windows on both the server's clock and the game's, and nothing is charged for a delivery that did not happen.

needs.why: Judges whether a player can afford a kit against the balance the running game holds this second, and reads the hour it is INSIDE the game. With the money switches off the price is checked against the last server save, so a player can send their money to a friend and still buy the kit. With the time switch off an in-game time window is not applied at all — the kit or command is handed out at any hour, exactly as if no in-game window were set, and the plugin's tab says so on the window itself. The name, position and health switches fill the {ping}, {sector} and {health} tokens; with them off those tokens read "?". All of them are reads and none of them changes anything in the game.
